remarks: Complete upscale renovated 1st floor apartment. Enjoy the lifestyle of living in the East Norwalk water community. This 1st floor apartment offers 2 BRs, plus an office, chef's kitchen, Primary en Suite BR, 2nd BR & 2 full Baths and a Garage!  Enter into a common hallway w/motion lighting. Then into the Living Room w/hardwood flooring & recessed lighting & a private office area just off the LR. Into the primary enSuite w/double closets , full bath w/frameless shower enclosure, oversized vanity & plenty of natural lighting.  An Eat-in-Kitchen any cook would enjoy w/lots of quartz countertops to prepare, cabinets & stainless appliances, 2nd bedroom w/huge walk-in closet and just across the hall from a 2nd full bath.  Lower level basement for storage and full size washer & dryer for 1st floor tenant use only. Enjoy the salt air, sunsets & gentle harbor breezes while relaxing on your front porch.  Central air, tankless hot water heater, efficient gas heating. Walk/bike to all East Norwalk amenities, beaches, train station(s), restaurants, liquor store, farm to table market, SoNo, and so much more. Perfect commuter location only 55 miles north of NYC. Must have good credit & references, 2 months security. Off street, on street & garage parking. NO pets please. Front porch, 1 car garage and basement exclusively for 1st floor Tenant's use.
